name: federated-research
description: Federated research: a local PM frames the question, the heavy research is delegated to a remote agent over the A2A protocol, and a local writer synthesizes the memo. Shows the `a2a` node composing with retry / timeout / onError — if the remote agent is unreachable, a local summarizer covers the gap.

phases.name: frame-the-question
phases.prompt:
Turn this request into a crisp research brief — scope, key questions, and what a good answer looks like:

${input}

onError.name: local-fallback-research
onError.prompt:
The remote research agent was unreachable (${error.message}). Produce the best findings you can from the brief alone:

${brief}

phases.name: synthesize
